summary: Performance marketing telemetry architecture, tracking validation protocol, A/B experiment execution blueprint, unit economics guardrails, and marketing operations governance for the 65W GaN USB-C Charger launch across Vietnam marketplace channels (Shopee, Lazada, TikTok Shop). Built to enforce empirical measurement integrity, prevent margin destruction, and rigorously test creative-to-conversion hypotheses.

measurement_context_audit.business_objective: Achieve top-3 marketplace contender rank in the 65W GaN segment within 90 days while securing profitable first-order unit economics and review velocity (>4.8 stars).
measurement_context_audit.campaign_objective: Demand capture and high-intent acquisition on Shopee, Lazada, and TikTok Shop for Vietnamese urban professionals.
measurement_context_audit.primary_kpi: First-Order Net Contribution Margin (VND) & Blended Cost Per Acquisition (CPA <= 120,000 VND).
secondary_kpis: Product Detail Page (PDP) Click-to-Purchase Conversion Rate (CVR %)
Search Advertising Cost of Sales (ACOS % / ROAS)
measurement_context_audit.time_window: Initial 30-Day Launch & Calibration Flight (Phase 1: Days 1–14 Testing; Phase 2: Days 15–30 Scaling).

segment_and_channel.geographic_focus: Hanoi & Ho Chi Minh City (Urban Metro Hubs)
channels: TikTok Shop Video Shopping Ads & Creator Affiliate Seeding
segment_and_channel.target_audience: Urban professionals & remote workers (Ages 22–35) using USB-C PD ultrabooks/MacBooks.

tested_angles: Angle 01: Kitchen Scale Weigh-In (350g OEM vs 100g GaN)
Angle 02: Coffee Shop Loose Socket Friction Teardown
creative_variant_and_offer.price_points: 369,000–399,000 VND (Flash Promo Corridor) / 429,000 VND (Standard Retail Anchor)

attribution_context.attribution_model: Last-Click Platform Model reconciled against Backend ERP / Marketplace Settled Orders (7-day click / 1-day view default).
attribution_context.attribution_caveats: Marketplace platform-reported ROAS typically over-attributes view-through conversions; all decisions require cross-referencing net settled cash flow.

primary_sources: Shopee Seller Center Open API Telemetry
data_source_and_freshness.reporting_lag_window: 24 to 72 hours for complete COD return reconciliations.

event_tracking_architecture.denominator_definition: Per 1,000 Ad Impressions delivered within target keyword/demographic cluster
event_tracking_architecture.telemetry_source: Shopee Ads API / TikTok Ads Manager
event_tracking_architecture.diagnostic_function: Evaluates platform bidding competitiveness and category search volume.

event_tracking_architecture.denominator_definition: Total 3-Second Video Views / Total Video Impressions
event_tracking_architecture.diagnostic_function: Measures creative pattern interrupt effectiveness (Scene 01 visual scale weigh-in).

event_tracking_architecture.denominator_definition: Outbound PDP Link Clicks / Total Impressions
event_tracking_architecture.telemetry_source: Shopee Search / Lazada Discovery / TikTok Ad Center
event_tracking_architecture.diagnostic_function: Measures ad headline, thumbnail, and hook relevance before PDP arrival.

event_tracking_architecture.denominator_definition: Unique Add-to-Cart Actions / Unique PDP Visitors
event_tracking_architecture.diagnostic_function: Measures initial offer resonance and price perception.

event_tracking_architecture.denominator_definition: Completed Settled Orders / Total In-Shop Clicks
event_tracking_architecture.diagnostic_function: Measures PDP conversion power, trust signals, and objection neutralization.

event_tracking_architecture.denominator_definition: Total Marketing Spend (VND) / Total Attributed Units Sold
event_tracking_architecture.telemetry_source: Ad Spend Reports + ERP Order Logs
event_tracking_architecture.diagnostic_function: Ensures marketing spend stays within unit margin constraints (<= 120,000 VND).
Monitors compatibility complaints, thermal dissatisfaction, and product defect signals.

tracking_integrity_rules: Rule 01: Enforce standardized UTM campaign naming across all external influencer links: utm_source=tiktok&utm_medium=affiliate&utm_campaign=gan65_launch&utm_content={creator_id}_{angle_id}.
Rule 02: Deduplicate marketplace affiliate conversions against direct in-app search ads via unique promotional voucher codes.
Rule 03: Reconcile daily reported ad platform spend against settled Shopee/Lazada wallet statements to prevent currency/FX drift.

experiment_design_and_statistical_protoc.experiment_title: Laptop Dual Replacement Hook vs Generic GaN Speed Hook on Shopee Search

test_structure.variant_a_control: Generic High-Tech GaN Hook ('Củ Sạc GaN 65W Siêu Nhanh - Chuẩn PD Quốc Tế')
test_structure.variant_b_treatment: Everyday Carry Problem Hook ('Củ Sạc 65W Thay Thế Toàn Bộ Sạc Laptop & Điện Thoại - Nhẹ 100g')
test_structure.traffic_allocation: 50/50 Split on Shopee Search Ads targeting identical keyword cluster ('củ sạc 65w', 'sạc laptop type c')
test_structure.sample_size_requirement: Minimum 1,000 attributed clicks and >= 40 conversions per arm to ensure statistical stability.

evaluation_criteria.decision_boundary: Declare Variant B winner if CVR lift is >= 15% with non-overlapping 90% confidence bounds and ACOS <= 18%.
evaluation_criteria.inconclusive_protocol: If CVR difference is < 8% after 1,200 clicks per variant, declare INCONCLUSIVE and prioritize Angle 02 (Loose Socket) testing.
evaluation_criteria.guardrail_termination_trigger: Terminate variant immediately if ROAS falls below 3.5x over a 48-hour moving window with >= 200 clicks.

fatigue_detection_signals: Trailing 5-day Link CTR decay > 25% relative to initial 3-day baseline.
Audience frequency > 2.8 on TikTok retargeting pools accompanied by CPA inflation > 30%.
Shopee Search Ad average CPC inflation > 20% at identical ad quality score.
creative_fatigue_governance.fatigue_response_action: Do NOT apply arbitrary calendar-day pausing. Cycle secondary thumbnail assets and refresh the first 3.5 seconds of video hooks while preserving winning PDP copy.

stop_loss_governance.stop_loss_rule: Enforce hard campaign budget stop if trailing 7-day blended CPA exceeds 120,000 VND or if campaign contribution margin falls below 10% of revenue.
stop_loss_governance.authorization_boundary: Budget scaling beyond 15,000,000 VND daily spend requires CMO sign-off and verified 14-day return rate < 3.0%.

funnel_bottleneck_diagnostic_matrix.telemetry_symptom: High TikTok 3s Hook Rate (>40%) + Low Outbound Click-to-Shop Rate (<1.2%)
funnel_bottleneck_diagnostic_matrix.identified_bottleneck: Vampire Entertainment / Lack of Commercial Transition in Scene 02
funnel_bottleneck_diagnostic_matrix.root_cause_hypothesis: Video entertains with the scale weigh-in but fails to clearly communicate laptop compatibility or shopping basket link before second 20.
funnel_bottleneck_diagnostic_matrix.corrective_action: Shift product value statement and yellow shopping cart overlay forward to second 8.0 in video edit.

funnel_bottleneck_diagnostic_matrix.telemetry_symptom: High Search Ad CTR (>6.5%) + Low PDP Conversion Rate (<2.0%)
funnel_bottleneck_diagnostic_matrix.identified_bottleneck: Destination Bridge Disconnect / Pricing & Trust Friction
funnel_bottleneck_diagnostic_matrix.root_cause_hypothesis: Shoppers clicked searching for 'sạc laptop macbook' but doubted thermal safety or warranty legitimacy upon reading PDP details.
funnel_bottleneck_diagnostic_matrix.corrective_action: Move Slide 4 (12-Month 1-to-1 Replacement Warranty badge) to Slide 2 in the PDP carousel; add verified unboxing reviews to top of description.

funnel_bottleneck_diagnostic_matrix.telemetry_symptom: Healthy CVR (>5.0%) + High Return/Refund Rate (>4.0%) citing 'Does not charge laptop'
funnel_bottleneck_diagnostic_matrix.root_cause_hypothesis: Customers with 100W+ gaming laptops or proprietary non-PD USB-C ports purchased the 65W charger expecting full-speed charging.
funnel_bottleneck_diagnostic_matrix.corrective_action: Implement bold PDP compatibility checklist specifying: 'Tối ưu cho laptop văn phòng 65W Type-C PD (MacBook Air/Pro 13-14, Dell XPS, ThinkPad). Không dùng cho laptop gaming >100W'.

marketing_operations_and_audit_governanc.operational_mode: SUPERVISED MODE (Performance prepares automated tracking sheets, budget allocations, and bid scripts; external API mutations require human sign-off).

audit_logging_record.platform_target: Shopee Open API / TikTok Ads Manager
audit_logging_record.requested_action: Configure EXP-GAN65-VN-001 split test flight with 10,000,000 VND initial testing allocation and 120,000 VND CPA ceiling guardrail.

candidate_learning_framework.target_learning_inquiry: Does emphasizing 'Desk & Commute Freedom' via weight reduction yield higher commercial intent in Vietnam than raw technical wattage specifications?
candidate_learning_framework.validation_methodology: Replicate winning search headline across Lazada and TikTok Video Shopping Ads; monitor 30-day cohort repeat purchase rate.

performance_to_creative_feedback.telemetry_checkpoint: Track 3s Hook Drop Gradient and Scene 02 transition at 3.5s.
performance_to_creative_feedback.diagnostic_instruction: Ensure digital scale numbers (385g vs 100g) are visually legible on mobile screens without zooming. If 3s retention drops below 30%, replace kitchen scale with direct pocket-insertion hook.

performance_to_strategist_feedback.strategic_checkpoint: Validate whether 369,000–399,000 VND launch pricing generates target 5.5x ROAS on Shopee keyword cluster 'củ sạc gan 65w'.
performance_to_strategist_feedback.pivot_trigger: If keyword CPC exceeds 8,000 VND due to Baseus/Ugreen bidding wars, pivot 40% of demand capture budget into TikTok creator affiliate video ads.

performance_to_cmo_report.executive_summary: Testing framework ready for 30-day launch. Guardrails locked at 120k VND CPA and 3.5% refund ceiling. Projected first-order net margin of 75,000 VND per unit at 379k promo price.
performance_to_cmo_report.recommendation: Authorize 20,000,000 VND Phase 1 test budget under Supervised Mode.
